content.text: {"claim_true":false,"claim_reason":"Greedy minimality concerns the integer’s numerical value, not inclusion-minimality of its full prime-factor set. A least admissible integer can contain an unnecessary prime factor.","witness_valid":true,"witness_reason":"From 6, the least admissible next integer is 8. Above 8, 9 fails to share a prime with 8, while 10 shares 2 with both 6 and 8. Yet {2} alone hits {{2,3},{2}}, so {2,5} is not inclusion-minimal."}
